_doc: Ground texture rollout (bead bzc.138, docs/art/classes/grounds.md): pixen takes at 400 x 400 with the high top-down view, cropped, recoloured to each ground's colour and baked by tools/art/ground-bake.mjs (art/grounds/bake.json) into one tileable 12-cell texture per ground. The grass and sand also read takes of set ground-lab-pixen. Never the words texture or tile (pixen draws paving); never 'volcanic' (a volcano). Recipes are never edited after generation: add a new id (new seed) instead. '@name' values come from shared.

shared.steppe: Subject: calm dry steppe grassland seen from straight above, the grass running off every edge of the picture with no frame, no rim and no plate. Short dry straw-yellow grass #ccb86f with many small dry tufts and blades in darker #a8944e and paler #e4d494, a few tiny seed heads, soft uneven patches of slightly more golden and slightly more olive straw. Evenly lit, low contrast, calm. Painterly 16-bit strategy-game map ground.
shared.jungle: Subject: a calm lush jungle floor seen from straight above, the ground running off every edge of the picture with no frame, no rim and no plate. Deep green #65a25a moss and low leafy ground plants, many small fern fronds and leaves in darker #457a40 and lighter #86c070, a few fallen leaves, soft uneven patches of slightly bluer and slightly yellower green. Evenly lit, low contrast, calm. Painterly 16-bit strategy-game map ground.
shared.badlands: Subject: calm flat bare rust-red earth seen from straight above, the ground running off every edge of the picture with no frame, no rim and no plate. Smooth packed soil #b36a45 with soft fine grain in slightly darker #9a5a3a and lighter #c98058, a few small tan pebbles, a very few faint short hairline cracks, soft uneven patches of more orange and more brown soil. Evenly lit, low contrast, quiet, no deep cracks. Painterly 16-bit strategy-game map ground.
shared.wasteland: Subject: calm burnt ash-grey ground after a wildfire seen from straight above, the ground running off every edge of the picture with no frame, no rim and no plate. Grey ash #79726b with fine darker #5a544f soot grain and lighter #948c84 ash flecks, a few small charred twigs and pebbles, soft uneven patches of lighter and warmer ash. Evenly lit, low contrast, calm. Painterly 16-bit strategy-game map ground.
shared.snow: Subject: calm fresh snow seen from straight above, the snow running off every edge of the picture with no frame, no rim and no plate. Smooth snow #d5e2f5 with large soft wind drifts in slightly bluer #c2d2ec and whiter #eef4fc, faint thin curved wind lines, a few tiny glints. Evenly lit, very low contrast, calm. Painterly 16-bit strategy-game map ground.
shared.basalt: Subject: calm dark basalt rock ground seen from straight above, the rock running off every edge of the picture with no frame, no rim and no plate. Dark purple-grey basalt #42373f with fine grain in darker #2f272d and lighter #55484f, small dark pebbles, soft patches of grey ash, a few faint thin dark cracks. No lava, no glow. Evenly lit, low contrast, calm. Painterly 16-bit strategy-game map ground.
shared.sand: Subject: calm golden desert sand seen from straight above, the sand running off every edge of the picture with no frame, no rim and no plate. Smooth sand #e4b962 with many small soft wind ripples in lighter #f0cc84 and slightly darker #cfa452, a few tiny pebbles, soft uneven patches of paler and warmer sand. Evenly lit, low contrast, calm, no rocks. Painterly 16-bit strategy-game map ground.
shared.frosting: Subject: smooth pale pink strawberry icing seen from straight above, the icing running off every edge of the picture with no frame, no rim and no plate. Soft pink icing #f6cbd6 with gentle wavy palette-knife strokes in slightly deeper #ebb2c2 and creamier #fde6ec, a few tiny white sugar crystals, soft uneven patches of pinker and creamier icing. Evenly lit, low contrast, calm. Painterly 16-bit strategy-game map ground.
shared.swamp: Subject: calm wet swamp mud seen from straight above, the mud running off every edge of the picture with no frame, no rim and no plate. Murky olive mud #4f502d with soft mossy green patches #5f6a34, many tiny short dark reed flecks #3a3b20, a few small faint wet sheens, soft uneven patches of greener and browner mud. Evenly lit, low contrast, calm. Painterly 16-bit strategy-game map ground.
shared.badlands2: Subject: looking straight down at calm bare rust-red earth: only bare packed soil, nothing else, filling the whole picture edge to edge. Smooth packed soil #b36a45 with soft fine grain in slightly darker #9a5a3a and lighter #c98058, a few small tan pebbles, a few faint short hairline cracks, soft uneven patches of more orange and more brown soil. Lit from the bottom left. Painterly 16-bit strategy-game map ground.
shared.steppe2: Subject: looking straight down at a dry straw-yellow meadow: only short dry grass, nothing else, filling the whole picture edge to edge. Many small dry grass tufts and blades in straw #ccb86f with darker #a8944e shade between them and paler #e4d494 tips, a few tiny seed heads, soft uneven patches of slightly more golden and slightly more olive straw. Lit from the bottom left. Painterly 16-bit strategy-game map ground.
shared.jungle2: Subject: looking straight down at a lush mossy forest floor: only moss and tiny low leaves, nothing else, filling the whole picture edge to edge. Many small clumps of moss and clover-like leaves in deep green #65a25a with darker #457a40 shade between them and lighter #86c070 tips, a few tiny fallen leaves, soft uneven patches of slightly bluer and slightly yellower green. Lit from the bottom left. Painterly 16-bit strategy-game map ground.
shared.wasteland2: Subject: looking straight down at grey ash and cinders: only bare burnt ground, nothing else, filling the whole picture edge to edge. Soft grey ash #79726b with fine darker #5a544f soot grain and lighter #948c84 flecks, small charred twigs and grey pebbles, a few faint hairline cracks, soft uneven patches of lighter and warmer ash. Lit from the bottom left. Painterly 16-bit strategy-game map ground.
shared.snow2: Subject: looking straight down at smooth fresh snow: only snow, nothing else, filling the whole picture edge to edge. Soft white snow #d5e2f5 with many small soft wind ripples and drifts in slightly bluer #bccde8 shade and whiter #f2f7fd crests, a few tiny glints, soft uneven patches of bluer and whiter snow. Lit from the bottom left. Painterly 16-bit strategy-game map ground.
shared.frosting2: Subject: looking straight down at a wide flat field of smooth pale pink icing: only icing, nothing else, filling the whole picture edge to edge, no cake and no plate. Soft pink icing #f6cbd6 with many small soft wavy ridges left by a spreading knife in slightly deeper #ebb2c2 shade and creamier #fde6ec crests, a few tiny white sugar crystals, soft uneven patches of pinker and creamier icing. Lit from the bottom left. Painterly 16-bit strategy-game map ground.
